name: web-grid-pulse-interactive-pixel-grid-lighting-up-in-gradient-trail
title: White fine grid where squares light up in orange, pink, violet, blue and cyan along the pointer's path, under the heading 'grid pulse'
whatItIs: A white page with a fine hairline grid whose cells light in a sweeping arc from orange through red, magenta, violet and blue to cyan and fade out behind the pointer, with a huge black 'grid pulse' heading, a paragraph explaining the effect and a small Text toggle at the top right.
whatItMeans: Playful and tactile; a colour trail on a quiet grid rewards moving the cursor.
techniques: Light grid cells along the pointer path.

vocabulary.definition: Colour left behind by the cursor.
Cells lighting up and fading in a grid.
A gradual shift of hue along a path.
A grid of small hairline cells.
